We are looking for an AI Engineer / GenAI Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Agentic AI, LLM-based applications, Python, AWS AI/ML services, and data engineering. The candidate should be capable of designing, developing, integrating, and deploying AI-powered solutions in a production environment.

Design and develop Agentic AI solutions, AI agents, multi-step workflows, and tool/function calling.

Work extensively with AWS AI/ML services, particularly:
AWS Bedrock
Amazon Textract / OCR
Amazon SageMaker

Strong hands-on Python development experience.
Practical experience with Generative AI and LLMs.
Strong understanding and hands-on experience with Agentic AI / AI Agent development.
Experience with AWS Bedrock and other AWS AI/ML services.
Experience with OCR / document processing, preferably Amazon Textract.
Experience building RAG and LLM-powered applications.
Good knowledge of DynamoDB and PostgreSQL.
Experience with ETL/data pipelines and data processing.
Experience with Git/Bitbucket and CI/CD pipelines.
